items.text: Kwathi ngosuku uMose aqeda ngalo ukumisa
, waligcoba, walahlukanisela iNkosi, lempahla yalo yonke, lezitsha zalo zonke;
izikhulu zakoIsrayeli, eziyizinhloko zezindlu lezikhulu zezizwe, ezazibusa labo ababalwayo,

zaletha iminikelo yazo eNkosini, inqola eziyisithupha ezembesiweyo lenkabi ezilitshumi lambili; ngazimbili zaletha inqola eyodwa, esinye lesinye saletha inkabi eyodwa; zaziletha phambi kweTabernakeli.
INkosi yasisithi kuMose:
Zamukele kuzo, ukuze zisetshenziswe enkonzweni yethente lokuhlangana, uzinike amaLevi, kulowo lalowo njengomsebenzi wakhe.
Ngakhoke uMose wathatha izinqola lezinkabi, wazinika amaLevi.
Wanika amadodana kaGerishoni inqola ezimbili lenkabi ezine, njengomsebenzi wawo;
lenqola ezine lenkabi ezificaminwembili wazinika amadodana kaMerari, njengomsebenzi wawo awenzayo ngokulaya kukaIthamari indodana kaAroni umpristi.
Kodwa amadodana kaKohathi kawanikanga lutho, ngoba wona anikwa umsebenzi wokulondoloza izinto ezingcwele ezimele ukuthwalwa emahlombe awo.
Izikhulu zanikela umnikelo wokwahlukaniselwa kwealtare ngosuku lokugcotshwa kwalo, zanikela umnikelo phambi kwealtare.
INkosi yathi kuMose: Izikhulu zizanikela iminikelo yokwahlukaniselwa kwealtare, ziyinikele ngamunye ngamunye ngensuku ezilandelanayo.
Owanikela ngomnikelo wakhe ngosuku lokuqala wayenguNashoni indodana kaAminadaba, owesizwe sakoJuda.
Umnikelo wakhe wawungumganu wesiliva, ubunzima bawo
alikhulu lamatshumi amathathu; umganu wokuchela wesiliva, ubunzima bawo
angamatshumi ayisikhombisa,
lendlu engcwele; yomibili yayigcwele impuphu ecolekileyo ixubene lamafutha, kube ngumnikelo wempuphu;
inkezo yegolide, ubunzima bayo
alitshumi, igcwele impepha;
inkunzi eyodwa, lenqama eyodwa, lewundlu elilomnyaka munye, zibe ngumnikelo wokutshiswa;
impongo eyodwa ibe ngumnikelo wesono;
okomhlatshelo weminikelo yokuthula kwaba yizinkabi ezimbili, lenqama ezinhlanu, lempongo ezinhlanu, lawawundlu amahlanu alomnyaka munye. Lokho kwakungumnikelo kaNashoni indodana kaAminadaba.

Lezizinto zaziyiminikelo eyanikelwa yizikhulu zakoIsrayeli, ziyiminikelo yokwahlukaniselwa kwealtare ngosuku lokugcotshwa kwalo. Kwanikelwa imiganu yesiliva elitshumi lambili, lemiganu yokuchela yesiliva elitshumi lambili, lenkezo zegolide ezilitshumi lambili;
ubunzima balowo lalowomganu
alikhulu lamatshumi amathathu; ubunzima balowo lalowomganu wokuchela
angamatshumi ayisikhombisa; ubunzima besiliva sonke salezizinto
azinkulungwane ezimbili, lamakhulu amane, ngokweshekeli lendlu engcwele.
Kwanikelwa lezinkezo zegolide ezilitshumi lambili, zigcwele impepha; ubunzima baleyo laleyonkezo
alitshumi ngokweshekeli lendlu engcwele; ubunzima begolide lonke lezinkezo
alikhulu lamatshumi amabili.

Zonke izifuyo zomnikelo wokutshiswa zaziyizinkunzi ezilitshumi lambili, lenqama ezilitshumi lambili, lamawundlu alitshumi lambili alomnyaka munye, kanye lomnikelo wempuphu oqondene lalezo; lempongo ezilitshumi lambili zomnikelo wesono.

Zonke izifuyo zomhlatshelo weminikelo yokuthula zaziyizinkunzi ezingamatshumi amabili lane, lenqama ezingamatshumi ayisithupha, lempongo ezingamatshumi ayisithupha, lamawundlu angamatshumi ayisithupha alomnyaka munye. Lokho kwakungumnikelo wokwahlukaniselwa kwealtare, emva kokugcotshwa kwalo.
Lapho uMose engena ethenteni lokuhlangana ukukhuluma leNkosi, wezwa ilizwi likhuluma, livela ngaphezu kwesihlalo somusa esisemtshokotshweni wobufakazi, ngaphakathi
amabili; lakhuluma kuye.
